note: Plan 0026, R10, D8: the people of the showcase of Bãi Trước (scenes/world/showcase_people.gd). The walkers go back and forth along the footways of the park and the ways of the walk of the sea, keep_right_m to the right of the middle of the way (less on a narrow way), and stop when the player stands in front of them; the sitters sit on the borders of the raised lawns, with their backs to the lawn. hours gives the part of the people that is there at each hour: [hour, part]. At 17:00 all of them are there (about 40, R10); at noon fewer. The culture notes (Confirmed): in the evening many families come to Bãi Trước, swim, and sit on the paved edge of the park. The swimmers wait for the swim clothes and the swim rings of World (request Q-W6). The counts and the parts are builder values. spots: some of the walkers walk on a short way in the frame of a shot (report 0026, D-0026-07: at 17:00 people walk on the walk of the sea and in the park, near the places of the shots and of the player); the others go on the ways of the park.
